critical_caveats: Counts mix cumulative ('Cumules') and new ('Nouveaux') observations; do not sum these together.
Both aggregate and location-level rows exist; do not add them together.
Many start dates and values are missing; missing is not zero.
Rows do not identify virus species in a dedicated field; verify against original reports before species-specific analysis.
DRC outbreak counts must not be mapped onto Cameroon districts or interpreted as Cameroon cases.
Geography includes 197 district features but needs validation against current official Cameroon health district boundaries.
